Drawback: Overheating.description:
🌡️ Your Quirk builds heat in your body faster than you can shed it, or cold, for a frost Quirk.

⚠️ Push it and you flush, then cramp, then collapse.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Endeavor (Hellflame), Shoto Todoroki (Half-Cold Half-Hot).

🎒 Starts with: Cooling vest
Drawback: Overheating.traitNarrativeEffects: Using the Quirk raises body temperature; a cold Quirk reverses it (frost and numbness). Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): flushed skin, heavy sweat or steam (skin frost if cold), thirst, racing pulse. Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; dizziness, cramps, wavering output; any use beyond light scorches or frostbites the skin where the Quirk leaves the body (a minor injury). Quirk Strain 100: heatstroke (or hypothermia) drops the user: serious injury, collapse or near-collapse, no Quirk use until Strain is below 60. A working Cooling vest draws heat out (or puts it back): worn, it keeps the 60 stage (50 Exceptional) mild, not the 80 or 100 stages. Shade, cold water and rest ease symptoms but do not lower Strain faster. Signs fade as Strain drops below each threshold. Ordinary life: summer heat, crowded trains and hot baths wear the user down faster; they drink plenty of water and dress for their Quirk. Quirkless: no effect; the vest is spare gear.
